headline: Heavy Fighting Persists in Callums Cape and Mooring County
war_summary: Since the morning dispatch, the heaviest front-line action has concentrated sharply in the northwest, where Callums Cape and Mooring County remain the epicenters of intense combat. Callums Cape saw seven fresh strategic base turnovers in the past two hours, driven by furious back-and-forth contests around Scouts Jest, Naofa, and Ire, while sustaining over twenty-eight hundred combined casualties. In adjacent Mooring County, fighting over The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast generated six strategic shifts and nearly twenty-eight hundred casualties across the two-hour window. In contrast, the sudden surge reported earlier in Godcrofts has abruptly cooled, with casualty rates plummeting and no base exchanges occurring in the last two hours. Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse have likewise paused strategic transfers during the latest two-hour interval, though casualty counts remain moderate to elevated along both sectors. Nevish Line and Marban Hollow continue to exhibit quiet conditions after substantial engagements earlier in the day.
